educationalGoal: This course is an introductory course to help students develop the four basic skil ls of communication (reading, writing, speaking, and listening) in modern Japanese . Students will learn the Japanese writing system (hiragana & katakana), fundament al grammatical structures of Japanese, and practice simple conversational skills s uch as self-introductions. Students will also learn and practice basic phrases use d in daily class time activities.
advice: The class will be conducted using the following topics: Lesson 1 Self-introduction Lesson 2 Shopping Lesson 3 Describing locations Lesson 4 Asking for directions Lesson 5 Talking about activities 1 Lesson 6 Talking about activities 2 Lesson 7 Talking about activities 3 Lesson 8 Describing items Lesson 9 Inviting a friend, accepting/declining an invitation Lesson 10 Talking about past activities Lesson 11 Describing past activities Reading & Writing Onomatopes & mimetics
